summary: Getting too close to an end gateway causes the game to crash
description: The bug Going too close to the end gateway will cause the game to crash! Stack trace 1.15 Pre-release 1 : [^crash-2019-11-21_23.27.56-client.txt] Description: Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16 at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBounds(Preconditions.java:64) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBoundsCheckIndex(Preconditions.java:70) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.checkIndex(Preconditions.java:248) at java.base/java.util.Objects.checkIndex(Objects.java:372) at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:458) at dsy.a(SourceFile:41) at dsx.a(SourceFile:30) at dsx.a(SourceFile:11) at dsk.a(SourceFile:106) at dsk.b(SourceFile:95) at dsk.a(SourceFile:127) at dsk.a(SourceFile:95) at dqm.a(SourceFile:1180) at dqi.a(SourceFile:719) at dqi.a(SourceFile:549) at dbj.d(SourceFile:941) at dbj.b(SourceFile:576) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:202)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.15 Pre-release 1.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Locate an end gateway in the End dimension.
4. Move close to the end gateway until it is within rendering distance.
5. Wait approximately 1 second and observe the game crash.
6. Note the crash report generated in the `crash-reports` folder.
Observed Behavior: Getting too close to an end gateway in Minecraft causes the game to crash, specifically when the player approaches within a certain distance that triggers the rendering of the block entity. This issue has been observed in version 1.15 Pre-release 1, leading to a crash report that cites a java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException, indicating that an index of 16 was accessed, which is out of bounds for a length of 16. The crash occurs during the rendering process, as evidenced by the stack trace that follows the error, detailing several calls that lead up to the crash, including methods from the rendering classes. Players have reported that the game crashes immediately upon entering the vicinity of the end gateway, and attempts to re-enter the game result in repeated crashes, making it impossible to navigate away from the area without addressing the bug. This issue has been consistently replicated, with multiple users experiencing the same problem, which suggests that it is a critical bug that requires attention from developers to ensure stability and prevent gameplay disruption.
Expected Behavior: When approaching an end gateway, the game should render the gateway without causing any crashes or errors. Players should be able to view and interact with the end gateway without experiencing an IndexOutOfBoundsException or other rendering issues. This expected behavior should remain consistent across all game modes and versions, allowing for smooth gameplay and exploration in the End dimension.
